questions.question: What city does Psalm 87 glorify?
options: Sinai, the mountain of the law

questions.question: What is said about those born in Zion?
options: A curse rests on all who are numbered among them
They will all be scattered and quite forgotten among the nations
Glorious things are spoken, and the Most High establishes her
They are doomed to be carried away into exile
questions.answer: Glorious things are spoken, and the Most High establishes her

questions.question: The psalm pictures various nations being counted as born in Zion.
Glorious things of you are spoken, O city of _____.
The LORD loves the gates of _____ more than all the dwelling places of Jacob.
